exposure: history of premature rupture of membranes
cohort: 152 preterm babies born at Dhulikhel Hospital, Kavre, Nepal
finding: The most common modifiable risk factors for preterm birth were inadequate antenatal visits, history of premature rupture of membranes, history of urinary tract infection, and weight less than 45 kg.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was vaginal route (60.53%) followed by cesearean section in 37.50%.
gest_age: Majority of the premature babies were in the gestational age of 28 to 32 weeks (60%).
birth_weight: There were 5.26% babies less than 1000 grams and the least weight being 700 grams.
